exposure: Group EMDR therapy (Group Traumatic Episode Protocol - GTEP) delivered as video-conference psychotherapy (VCP) with therapist rotation
cohort: The participants were 85 frontline mental health, emergency, law enforcement, and social workers who experienced psychological distress in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: Group EMDR therapy delivered remotely significantly reduced symptoms of PTSD, generalized anxiety, and depression in frontline workers, but showed no treatment effect on moral injury.
